content.short: AI smart ring that tracks sleep, HRV and recovery and rewards healthy habits.
content.description: CUDIS sells a $399 smart ring that records activity, sleep, blood oxygen, HRV and stress around the clock, with AI guidance on what to improve and no subscription fee. Challenges and health points turn routines into rewards, and leaderboards add some friendly competition. It counts more than 250,000 members and World users can track their ring from inside World App.
